title: cotoneaster rugosus var. henryanus
intro: Cotoneaster rugosus var. henryanus, commonly known as the rough-leaved cotoneaster, is a type of flowering plant native to China. Research suggests that the plant has potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Cotoneaster rugosus var. henryanus have been identified to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing stress and anxiety, and promoting relaxation. However, more studies are needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential of this plant.
